description: One active priced add-on product in an add-on group of the given display type on a given configurable parent, one row per add-on in display order, with its SKU (dropdown option value), name and group. Several needs get distinct add-ons. KB: Configuring Product Add-ons.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

parentSku.description: SKU of the configurable parent the test opened (ZnodePimProduct.SKU); link it to the parent need's output, e.g. "@product.parentProductSku"

addOnDisplayType.description: Stored ZnodePimAddonGroup.DisplayType of the add-on group the test selects from (CheckBox, RadioButton or DropDown)
